name: technology-intelligence
description: Capability-first technology decisions map needs to frameworks, platforms, document tools, and CLI/SDK/WASM/MCP/API/skill interfaces using dated evidence, explicit gaps, and runtime boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Dated evidence for contextual technology choices.
interface.longDescription: Start from a needed capability, compare candidate technologies, inspect their documented CLI, SDK, WASM, MCP, API, app, or skill interfaces, and keep caller-supplied runtime availability separate. Dated primary-source observations preserve publication and measurement windows, explicit decision profiles, hard gates, alternatives, confidence, and visible evidence gaps. A separate maintenance workflow validates staleness and bounded-window coverage, reviews source and licensing constraints, captures hash-bound allowlisted refresh receipts outside tracked source, and proposes reviewable dataset changes without automatically changing recommendations or owning runtime installation and invocation.
capabilities: Experiment, startup, scale-up, and enterprise-critical decision profiles
Frontend, backend, data, infrastructure, CLI, MCP, A2A, ACP, API, SDK, and Agent Skills candidates
Document-processing candidates including AnyDoc with explicit OCR and benchmark boundaries
First-party evidence and independent-signal coverage gates
Explicit unknown, licensing, maturity, maintenance, security, and operational-load gaps
Deterministic offline validation, query, publication-window coverage, staleness, diff, and trigger-contract checks
Explicit allowlisted source capture with hash-bound receipts and no recommendation mutation
Read-only technology and interface joins to caller-supplied runtime capability inventories
defaultPrompt: Map this need to a capability, compare candidate technologies and interfaces, and recommend a context-appropriate shortlist with dated evidence and explicit gaps.
Audit and refresh the Technology Intelligence evidence snapshot without automatically changing its assessments.
